headline: JazzWorld reports 26.6% revenue growth in Q3 2026
summary: JazzWorld reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of PKR 144.9 billion, a 26.6% increase year-on-year. Digital services revenue grew 47.9%, while EBITDA rose 23.9% to PKR 65.2 billion.
why: Strong financial performance in the telecommunications sector indicates robust demand for digital services in emerging markets.

impacts.name: JazzWorld
impacts.why: Revenue and EBITDA growth are positive indicators of company health.
